name: MRC Agrotech Ltd.
summary: Operating from its headquarters in Mumbai, India, MRC Agrotech Ltd. commenced business on October 12, 2016. The firm specializes in the commerce of essential precious and ferrous alloys, as well as various metals. Its extensive product range features goods such as GI pipes, insulators, transmitters, graphite, cobalt, tungsten, heat exchangers, electrical conductors, and water pumps.
